an5.140:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati
an5.140:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā ca hoti hantā ca rakkhitā ca khantā ca gantā ca.
an5.140:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti
an5.140:2.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yamenaṃ hatthidammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāreti
an5.140:2.3: yadi vā katapubbaṃ yadi vā akatapubbaṃ
an5.140:2.4: taṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto suṇāti
an5.140:2.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti.
an5.140:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti
an5.140:3.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato hatthimpi hanati hatthārūhampi hanati assampi hanati assārūhampi hanati rathampi hanati rathikampi hanati pattikampi hanati
an5.140:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti.
an5.140:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo rakkhitā hoti
an5.140:4.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato rakkhati purimaṃ kāyaṃ rakkhati pacchimaṃ kāyaṃ rakkhati purime pāde rakkhati pacchime pāde rakkhati sīsaṃ rakkhati kaṇṇe rakkhati dante rakkhati soṇḍaṃ rakkhati vāladhiṃ rakkhati hatthārūhaṃ
an5.140:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo rakkhitā hoti.
an5.140:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti
an5.140:5.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheripaṇavasaṃkhatiṇavaninnādasaddānaṃ
an5.140:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
an5.140:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti
an5.140:6.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yamenaṃ hatthidammasārathi disaṃ peseti
an5.140:6.3: yadi vā gatapubbaṃ yadi vā agatapubbaṃ
an5.140:6.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti.
an5.140:7.1: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an5.140:8.1: evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa
an5.140:8.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā ca hoti hantā ca rakkhitā ca khantā ca gantā ca.
an5.140:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.140:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā hoti.
an5.140:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti hanati byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ … uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ … uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti hanati byantīkaroti … anabhāvaṃ gameti
an5.140:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu hantā hoti.
an5.140:11.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
an5.140:11.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati
an5.140:11.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
an5.140:11.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati
an5.140:11.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu rakkhitā hoti.
an5.140:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti
an5.140:12.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu khantā hoti.
an5.140:13.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yā sā disā agatapubbā iminā dīghena addhunā yadidaṃ sabbasaṃkhārasamatho sabbupadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ taṃ khippaññeva gantā hoti
an5.140:13.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu gantā hoti.
an5.140:14.1: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
